title: Dragon Fist
titleNative: ドラゴン・フィスト
synopsis: Born as an aberration different from the expectations of a chief's son, Fei Long has been ostracized by his own people. To prepare for his destined future role as chief of his clan, Fei Long is sent to Japan to complete his schooling and gain experience mingling with humans. In Japan, he discovers not everything is simple. Note: This manga has been published one volume per year for 12 years, so the artistic style changes rather drastically as you read further on. It's a chronicle of sorts of Katayama Shuu's growth as an artist.

synopsis: There's always just one surefire way to win in a romantic comedy—simply saying "I like you!" The girls who have feelings for high school boy Izumi spent their days unable to take that first step forward. [The School Idol Who Only Wants to Be Pampered When It's Just the Two of Them] Amane Amasaki. [Even Though I Was Disowned, My Former Fiancé Just Won't Leave Me Alone!] Hakua Shiragiku. [The Angel of the Academy... But the Devil Next to Her Is Surprisingly Easy] Haru Kasuga. However, transferring into their class is Nanao Nanase, a seemingly ordinary girl who is actually a natural-born main heroine! Nano starts her fierce assault on Izumi with her shameless and straightforward approach. "Izumi-kun, I like you. Please go out with me." "Here, say 'ahh'~♪" "Izumi-kun, you're the one who made me into this kind of girl, you know?" In a panic, Amane and the others can't help but spring into action—"This girl... She actually did it!?" (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Isekai Shoukan Ojisan no Juu Musou Life: Survival Game-zuki Salaryman wa Kaisha Owari ni Isekai e Chokki Suru
synopsis: The middle-aged man and airsoft enthusiast Daisuke Koga is summoned to a different world on his 40th birthday. Given the ability to turn airsoft guns into real guns, Daisuke must save the other world while traveling back and forth between reality and the fantasy world. Alongside female swordsman Rena, Daisuke becomes the only gun user and dominates in the fantasy world after work! (Source: Houbunsha, translated)

synopsis: Contracted with a no-name spirit, Brigitte Meidell is a disappointment to her noble family and the mockery of her peers at the Otoleanna Academy of Magic—except for one. Yuri Aurealis is intelligent, handsome…and oh so arrogant. He’s made enemies of the same people as Brigitte, meaning the two should get along just fine. However, his boorishness accidentally sparks a rivalry between them. It’s a competition that has the potential to bring the two closer than they ever thought…! (Source: Yen Press)

synopsis: Starting his second year of high school, Ren Tabata was determined to get over his loner past and make some new friends. The first person he approached was the girl next to him, Touko Sasaki, who seemed gloomy and a little intimidating at first, but he couldn't seem to take his eyes off her. A romantic comedy between two shy but cute people who don't want to be alone anymore! (Source: DoraDora Sharp#, translated)
